edits.old: **No personal data.** The rows this story reads carry identifiers, dates, a code and a counter. The addressee, the address and the contact value are read by rwb-source-data and used inside the file build as a token; they are never stored in `rwb_comms`, never logged, never put on the manifest beyond the claim-check reference and never put on an event. The file content is never logged, only its name, its record count and its hash.
edits.new:
**Personal data.** The rows this story reads carry identifiers, dates, a code and a counter; the contact fields DF-ACE-076, DF-ACE-077 and DF-ACE-078 are personal data, read through the rwb-source-data contract and never stored here. The addressee, the address and the contact value are read by rwb-source-data and used inside the file build as a token; they are never stored in `rwb_comms`, never logged, never put on the manifest beyond the claim-check reference and never put on an event. The file content is never logged, only its name, its record count and its hash.

**Open decision DL06.** DL06 is still open; this story builds on its assumptions ASM-0189, ASM-2559, ASM-2608 and ASM-2776, which the directive of 26 November 2026 confirms.
